candidate_sentences.text: Tallinna Sadam Group reported a profit of EUR 22.5 million for the financial year ended 31 December 2025, representing a 17.3% increase from the EUR 19.2 million recorded in 2024.
Total revenue decreased slightly by 0.8% to EUR 118.7 million, primarily due to a significant drop in charter fees from the icebreaker Botnica in the Other segment.
Consequently, operating profit grew by 12.2% to EUR 32.7 million, and adjusted EBITDA increased by 6.4% to EUR 56.5 million, with the adjusted EBITDA margin expanding from 44.4% to 47.6%.
Capital investments totaled EUR 33.2 million, a 14.4% decrease from the prior year, with major spending directed toward infrastructure in Paldiski South Harbour and Muuga Harbour.
The equity to assets ratio remained stable at 61%, and the share price increased by 22.7% to EUR 1.296 by year-end.

verified_key_information_units.information: Passenger business growth with 8.3 million passengers (+1.0% YoY), dominated by Tallinn-Helsinki route (+1% passengers), and cruise tourism recovery featuring 190 thousand cruise passengers (+25%) and 118 calls (+18), offset by Tallinn-Stockholm decline.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.4 Market overview: passengers and 5.6.1 Number of passengers

candidate_sentences.text: The passenger harbours segment also performed well, with the number of passengers growing by 1.0% to 8.3 million.

Revenue in this segment increased by 4%, supported by higher passenger numbers on the Tallinn–Helsinki route and an 18% increase in cruise ship calls, which reached a record number of winter cruise calls.

verified_key_information_units.information: Cargo volume recovery to 13.8 million tonnes (+5.1% YoY) driven by liquid bulk surge (+47%, led by ligroin and gasoline), transit goods growth (+75%), and dry bulk increase, partially offset by ro-ro and container declines.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.5 Market overview: cargo and 5.6.2 Cargo volume
